text:
emma: noticed unusual s3 PutObject activity from analytics-lambda in prod, cloudtrail flagged it. :eyes:

devops-bot: deploy event: infra-deploy/2026-03-19 by alex — changed iam/role analytics-service-role (PR #412)

samir: oncall — please freeze further deploys to that role. can someone share the IAM diff + commit hash?

alex: that was my change. I added a policy so telemetry-forwarder can upload snapshots to a telemetry bucket. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/412 commit 9f3b2c4. i didn't realize the role also had access to prod buckets. i'll prepare a revert.

maria: mitigation plan: 1) remove s3:PutObject from analytics-service-role 2) revoke active STS tokens issued to that role 3) add explicit Deny for arn:aws:s3:::production-* to that role until policy is fixed 4) start audit of objects written. i'll run the commands.

emma: cloudtrail excerpt shows 12 PutObject calls from analytics-lambda between 2026-03-19T21:21 and 21:27. keys: attachments/2026/03/19/*. Might be user uploads. Need scope of files and PII check.

samir: create incident ticket and notify data-protection. Also ask infra to rotate any short-lived creds tied to that role. oncall, can you page the infra oncall?

oncall-bot: Incident created INC-2026-83. Paging infra-oncall now.

alex: i've pushed revert PR #413 and applied it to staging. rolling back prod now. command i used: 
```
aws iam detach-role-policy --role-name analytics-service-role --policy-arn arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/TelemetryUploadFullAccess
```
will follow with an apply that removes the PutObject statement.

maria: also run this to invalidate sessions: 
```
aws sts revoke-session --role-session-name analytics-lambda || aws iam update-assume-role-policy --role-name analytics-service-role --policy-document file://new-trust.json
```
(we don't have revoke-session, use session token invalidation by rotating role's external id in our setup)

emma: quick evidence: listing of the new objects shows user_ids embedded in metadata. copying sample: 
```
PUT /production-bucket/attachments/2026/03/19/abc123.jpg 
user_id: user_2467
content-type: image/jpeg
```
we need to confirm whether these were supposed to be stored here. if not, treat as unauthorized write access.

samir: forensics: capture EBS snapshot of the Lambda execution environment, export environment variables, and preserve logs (retain CloudWatch group). add KMS key access logs to the bundle. if any KMS decrypts happened, list CMK IDs.

oncall-bot: assigned: alex (rollback + IAM patch), emma (audit + data-scope), samir (forensics + postmortem).

alex: rollback applied to prod at 21:33. IAM policy no longer contains PutObject for analytics-service-role. i've posted the revert diff in the PR. running a quick check for new PutObject calls.

maria: temporary policy guard: adding a deny condition in org-level SCP for s3:PutObject to prod buckets for non-admin roles until we add CI policy checks. will follow up with a policy diff.

emma: initial scan: 12 new objects, 0 signs of exfil beyond that. copying those objects to quarantine-bucket for review. tagging them quarantine=true.

samir: good. next steps: 1) run payload inspection for PII 2) audit which feature triggered the write path 3) add unit/integration test that fails CI if role adds wide s3 access 4) postmortem doc and timeline.

maria: follow-ups created in INC-2026-83: TASK-1 (CI policy guard), TASK-2 (least-privilege review for analytics team), TASK-3 (KMS key access review). assigning due dates and owners.

emma: closing immediate write vector. no active writes after rollback. will continue detailed forensics tomorrow. :thumbsup:
